name: pr-review-toolkit
description: PR review workflow skills for Codex: parallel review passes, documented PR comments, interactive resolution, and resolver-managed bounded fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Run parallel Codex PR reviews, document findings, resolve issues interactively, and fix selected issues.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for participating in the pr-review-toolkit workflow. codex-review-pass launches six read-only review subagents and returns a deduplicated bundle; pr-review-and-document publishes that bundle through the shared .pr-review-cache/pr-#.json contract; pr-review-resolver discusses unresolved findings one by one, coordinates decisions, and owns status updates; codex-fix-worker is resolver-managed and only fixes selected code.
defaultPrompt: Run a Codex PR review pass with six subagents.
Review this PR and document the results.
Fix one selected PR review issue.
Update the canonical PR review comment.
